=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- `.github/workflows/unblock_judge.yml`, `scripts/unblock_judge.sh`, `scripts/unblock_ledger.py`:142-145, 673-675, 548-559, 356-366 | severity=critical | confidence=[4]
  flagged_by: [openai_gpt-6-luna]
  PROBLEM: The Codex judge retains the OpenRouter API key while processing untrusted content, and verdict text containing the key is posted without redaction.
  WHY: Untrusted content could prompt the judge to include the key in a verdict field, which validation preserves and the workflow posts.
- scripts/unblock_judge.sh:285 | severity=critical | confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro]
  PROBLEM: The Telegram case in `unblock_run_ops` has unquoted parentheses in an argument, causing a bash parse-time syntax error.
  WHY: Bash parses the function body before `unblock_main` runs, so the script exits with code 2 and the continue-on-error workflow step silently does nothing.
- scripts/unblock_judge.sh:311 | severity=high | confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus]
  PROBLEM: The evidence fingerprint normalization removes all 3-or-more-digit numbers, including meaningful HTTP status codes.
  WHY: Failures with different status codes can produce the same fingerprint, causing the ledger’s never-repeat rule to prevent a different verdict.
- scripts/unblock_judge.sh:105, 492-499 | severity=high | confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus]
  PROBLEM: Marker lines extracted from comment bodies are not stripped of trailing carriage returns before matching.
  WHY: CRLF-terminated marker lines can fail exact matching, causing the judge to skip items, treat verdict history as empty, or miss fix-up completions.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:15925 | severity=high | confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus]
  PROBLEM: The failed-project scan batch concatenates failed projects with search results and slices the first 30 without prioritization or rotation.
  WHY: Failed projects beyond the selected 30 can remain excluded from every poll tick and never be offered to the unblock judge.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:15779 | severity=high | confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, qwen_qwen3_7-plus]
  PROBLEM: Fix-up request comment lines are split without stripping carriage returns before capture matching.
  WHY: CRLF-terminated lines can fail the marker capture, silently skipping the fix-up request.
- scripts/operator_step_issue.py:170-240 | severity=critical | confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus]
  PROBLEM: `upsert` updates the shared operator-step issue body using a read-modify-write PATCH, so concurrent writers can overwrite one another’s entries.
  WHY: Separate workflow jobs can read the same body and PATCH independent replacements; the last PATCH silently drops the other writer’s entry. DeepSeek and Qwen rate this BLOCKER; Minimax rates it MAJOR.
- scripts/operator_step_issue.py:231-232 | severity=critical | confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_8-flash, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_2]
  PROBLEM: Continuation lines in the `matches` generator expression mix spaces and tabs.
  WHY: Ruff reports E101, failing the `static-checks` job and aggregate `CI / lint` check.
- tests/test_pr_merge_status_guard.py:998-1004 | severity=critical | confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_8-flash, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_2]
  PROBLEM: The root and workflow-template guard copies are not byte-identical.
  WHY: `test_template_copies_are_identical` fails, contributing to the failed `tests-hooks-and-orchestrator` job and aggregate `CI / lint` check.
- scripts/operator_step_issue.py:242 | severity=high | confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_8-flash]
  PROBLEM: Retrieved comment bodies are compared to rendered entries without normalizing CRLF newlines.
  WHY: If the API body contains CRLF while the rendered entry uses LF, identical entries compare unequal and `upsert` posts duplicate comments. z-ai_glm-5_2 disputes this finding, stating GitHub REST normalizes line endings to LF and no runtime issue is demonstrated.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:15943-15945, scripts/unblock_scan.py:221-223 | severity=high | confidence=[4]
  flagged_by: [openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_2]
  PROBLEM: The six-hour cooldown check examines only the last 30 comments and can miss a trusted verdict marker when 30 newer comments arrive within the cooldown window.
  WHY: The scan may treat the marker as absent and dispatch another judge before six hours have elapsed.
- .claude/hooks/pr_merge_status_guard.py:621, workflow-templates/.claude/hooks/pr_merge_status_guard.py:646 | severity=critical | confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: The root guard’s assignment-skip regex does not recognize `NAME+=`, unlike the workflow-template copy.
  WHY: An `X+=1 git push` command can leave the walker treating `X+=` as the executable, so the merged-PR guard silently misses the git write.

=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

=== CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===
- requirement: Append keyed operator-step comments instead of PATCHing the shared issue body, resolve trusted writer identity, paginate existing comments, and handle stale tracker listings.
  expected_change_site: scripts/operator_step_issue.py (`upsert` and comment-loading logic); `.github/workflows/issue_pr_status.yml`; `.github/workflows/unblock_judge.yml`
  confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus]
  EVIDENCE: `scripts/operator_step_issue.py` still contains body-PATCH read-modify-write code at lines 194-209; `load_entry_comments`, trusted-login resolution, comment-based marker matching, and stale-listing convergence logic are absent; the workflows have no concurrency group.
- requirement: Add CRLF resilience to unblock marker parsing and fix-up request parsing with `rtrimstr("\r")`.
  expected_change_site: scripts/unblock_judge.sh (`unblock_latest_wait` and project-marker reconciliation); scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh (`handle_unblock_judge_project_hooks`)
  confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus]
  EVIDENCE: The cited marker-parsing expressions split comment bodies without trimming carriage returns; the inputs report no `rtrimstr("\r")` in those expressions.
- requirement: Change evidence fingerprint normalization from `\d{3,}` to `\b\d{6,}\b` to preserve meaningful 3-digit HTTP status codes.
  expected_change_site: scripts/unblock_judge.sh (`unblock_evidence` embedded Python heredoc, `norm` function)
  confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus]
  EVIDENCE: The `norm` function still uses `re.sub(r"\d{3,}", "", text)`.
- requirement: Prioritize failed projects in the 30-item scan batch and rotate the batch when more than 30 projects have failed.
  expected_change_site: scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh (`run_unblock_scan`, `numbers_json` assignment)
  confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus]
  EVIDENCE: The current expression concatenates project numbers and slices the first 30 without rotation; no rotation offset is present.
- requirement: Add tests for keyed operator-step comment preservation, HTTP status codes in evidence fingerprints, CRLF wait markers, CRLF handling, and failed-project rotation.
  expected_change_site: tests/test_unblock_judge.py; tests/test_unblock_scan.py (`test_project_hooks_run_before_the_command_handlers`)
  confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, qwen_qwen3_7-plus]
  EVIDENCE: The three named tests are absent from `tests/test_unblock_judge.py`; the cited `tests/test_unblock_scan.py` assertions for `rtrimstr`, `$all_projects`, and the rotation offset are absent.
- requirement: Make the root `.claude/hooks/pr_merge_status_guard.py` byte-identical to its workflow-template twin.
  expected_change_site: .claude/hooks/pr_merge_status_guard.py; workflow-templates/.claude/hooks/pr_merge_status_guard.py
  confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  EVIDENCE: The root file is reported as 1474 lines and the template as 1501 lines; the root assignment regex at line 621 lacks the `\+?` quantifier present at line 646 in the template.

=== END CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===
